source: Operational Productivity Phase 3.2 - Nucleus Blueprint + Guide Blueprint
name: Guide Blueprint Contract
objective: Define the declarative boundary for future public nucleus guide pages.
responsibilities: model visual structure without HTML or CSS
model SEO requirements without changing current SEO
model dynamic content aggregation by configuration
model ordering, featured content, filters, fallback and limits
model Testing, Validation and Publishing expectations
notes: Guide Blueprint receives future assets by configuration after approved integration.
Ordering and featured content must never be hardcoded in HTML.
